// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © BackQuant

//@version=6
indicator(
 "Deadband Hysteresis Filter [BackQuant]",
 overlay = true,
 precision = 2,
 format = format.price,
 timeframe = "",
 timeframe_gaps = true
 )

// Inputs
groupCalc = "Calculation"
series float pricesource = input.source(close, "Price Source", group = groupCalc, tooltip = "Series the filter tracks and smooths")
string thrMode = input.string("ATR", "Threshold Mode", options = ["ATR", "Percent", "Ticks", "Points"], group = groupCalc, tooltip = "Deadband base: ATR=ta.atr(atrLen)*atrMult, Percent=pctThresh% of price, Ticks=syminfo.mintick*tickThresh, Points=ptsThresh")
simple int atrLen = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval = 1, group = groupCalc, inline = "a", tooltip = "ATR period when Threshold Mode = ATR")
simple float atrMult = input.float(1.0, "ATR Mult", step = 0.1, group = groupCalc, inline = "a", tooltip = "Multiplier on ATR to set deadband width")
simple float pctThresh = input.float(0.5, "Percent Threshold", step = 0.1, group = groupCalc, inline = "b", tooltip = "Deadband as percent of price when Threshold Mode = Percent")
simple int tickThresh = input.int(10, "Tick Threshold", minval = 1, group = groupCalc, inline = "c", tooltip = "Deadband in ticks when Threshold Mode = Ticks")
simple float ptsThresh = input.float(5.0, "Points Threshold", step = 0.1, group = groupCalc, inline = "c", tooltip = "Deadband in price points when Threshold Mode = Points")
simple float enterMult = input.float(1.0, "Enter Mult", minval = 0.1, step = 0.1, group = groupCalc, inline = "d", tooltip = "Outer band. Move baseline only when |price - baseline| > base * Enter Mult")
simple float exitMult = input.float(0.5, "Exit Mult", minval = 0.05, step = 0.05, group = groupCalc, inline = "d", tooltip = "Inner band for hysteresis. Hold while inside. Should be less than Enter Mult")
simple float response = input.float(0.2, "Response", minval = 0.01, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.01, group = groupCalc, tooltip = "Baseline step when outside enter band. Higher = faster, lower = smoother")

groupUI = "UI Settings"
simple bool showFilter = input.bool(true, "Show Filtered Price on chart", group = groupUI, tooltip = "Toggle plot of the filtered baseline")
simple bool paintCandles = input.bool(true, "Paint candles according to Trend", group = groupUI, tooltip = "Color candles using filter slope")
color longColor = input.color(#33ff00, "Long Color", group = groupUI, inline = "col")
color shortColor = input.color(#ff0000, "Short Color", group = groupUI, inline = "col")


// Base threshold per mode
getBaseTau(mode, src) =>
    float base = na
    if mode == "ATR"
        base := ta.atr(atrLen) * atrMult
    else if mode == "Percent"
        base := math.abs(src) * pctThresh * 0.01
    else if mode == "Ticks"
        base := syminfo.mintick * tickThresh
    else
        base := ptsThresh
    nz(base)

// Deadband hysteresis core
var float dbhf = na
if na(dbhf)
    dbhf := pricesource

baseTau   = getBaseTau(thrMode, pricesource)
em        = math.max(enterMult, 0.0001)
xm        = math.min(exitMult, em)
tauEnter  = baseTau * em
tauExit   = baseTau * xm

diff = pricesource - dbhf

// Only move when outside enter band. Hold when inside exit band. Between bands do nothing.
if diff >  tauEnter
    dbhf += response * (diff - tauEnter)
else if diff < -tauEnter
    dbhf += response * (diff + tauEnter)
// else no update

// Trend from filtered slope
var int Trend = 0
if dbhf > dbhf[1]
    Trend := 1
if dbhf < dbhf[1]
    Trend := -1

// Coloring
var color barColour = color.white
if Trend == 1
    barColour := longColor
if Trend == -1
    barColour := shortColor

// Plot
barcolor(paintCandles ? barColour : na)
plot(showFilter ? dbhf : na, "DBHF", color = color.new(barColour, 40), linewidth = 4)

// Alerts
longFlip  = ta.crossover(dbhf, dbhf[1])
shortFlip = ta.crossunder(dbhf, dbhf[1])

alertcondition(longFlip,  "DBHF Up Slope",   "Deadband Hysteresis Filter slope turned up {{exchange}}:{{ticker}}")
alertcondition(shortFlip, "DBHF Down Slope", "Deadband Hysteresis Filter slope turned down {{exchange}}:{{ticker}}")
